title: Non-perturbative, background independent Fock representations for canonical quantum gravity
summary: A UV complete quantum field theory of general relativity is believed to require a non-perturbative approach. Moreover, background independence of classical general relativity supplies a physical selection for suitable Hilbert space representations of the quantum geometry and matter fields. In this contribution we show that, contrary to common intuition, there exist rigorous, background independent Fock representations available for a non-perturbative canonical quantisation of geometry and suitable matter fields.
